080f9ef8.reason: MusicTrack_Stop is routed to the canonical Game family but the ROM says it is Agbcc. It begins 70b5 = push {r4,r5,r6,lr}, and the canonical route passes -fcall-used-r4, which cannot save r4. Its first 64 bytes are byte-identical to gs2-en 081c1b94, the shared prebuilt sound engine, and its immediate register neighbours 080f9a30, 080f9a50 and 080fa1fc are already members of AGBCC_SOURCES while 080f9ef8 is not. Measured 2026-09-09 while auditing GS2 compiler routing and re-measured 2026-09-10. Recompiling the draft with the canonical flags minus -fcall-used-r4 produces push {r4, r5, r6, lr}, matching the reference prologue, and drops the residual from 30 differing halfwords to 22; what remains is a different bit-test idiom (the reference uses movs r0, #128 then tst r0, r1 where the draft shifts and compares), which is ordinary reconstruction. Nothing compiles it today because the owner is still retained assembly, but the routing test game_code_always_compiles_with_the_canonical_flags in tools/alchemy/src/compiler/routing.rs names 080f9ef8.c in its canonical-flags list, so the first ordinary C written for it would be compiled by the wrong family and could not match. Family membership is provenance and only Pascal may change a family route; this entry records the evidence and proposes moving the owner to AGBCC_SOURCES and choosing a different example for that test.

08006b84.reason: Routed to the canonical Game family, but the ROM contradicts that family ABI. The owner begins b510 = push {r4, lr} and then uses r4 immediately, while the Game route passes -fcall-used-r4, which makes r4 call-clobbered so GCC never saves it. The draft accordingly emits push {lr} and comes out 32 bytes against a 34-byte reference. Recompiling the same source with the canonical flags minus -fcall-used-r4 produces push {r4, lr}, the correct 34-byte length, and cuts the residual from 8 differing halfwords to 4; the four that remain are one rotated group at +0x10 (3b01 7008 3401 3101 against 7008 3401 3101 3b01), which is ordinary statement-order work rather than a route problem. The owner also sits inside the agbcc runtime block: 08006878, 08006910, 08006a00, 08006af8, 08006ba8, 08006c68, 08006cdc, 08006d50, 08006e24, 08006f84, 08007028, 08007098, 0800711c, 080071a8 and 08007220 are all AGBCC_SOURCES members and 08006b84 is a gap between two of them. Measured 2026-09-10 by a prologue audit over all 406 drafts, which found 22 r4-saving prologues of which 20 are already routed Agbcc and only this owner and 080f9ef8 are not. Family membership is provenance and only Pascal may change a family route; this entry records the evidence and proposes moving the owner to AGBCC_SOURCES. A second route discriminator was tried and ruled out: agscc emits pop {..., pc} only when TARGET_INTERWORK is clear, so a GS1 owner returning that way could not belong to a family passing -mthumb-interwork. Scanning all 406 drafts found only 080ab5e4 and 080dbc30, and both are false positives. 080dbc30 reaches its hit at +0x110, immediately beside the reference-indirect-dispatch at 0x10c, so the halfword is jump-table data rather than a return, and its nine residual halfwords are pure adjacent-instruction swaps with wrong_instructions=0. 080ab5e4 is the recorded regional-source-divergence candidate at 2293 differing halfwords, far too distant to attribute to a route. Only the -fcall-used-r4 prologue discriminator yields route conclusions in GS1. The same audit was pointed at the 45 drafts merged on 2026-09-10, 98274 bytes including the largest owners in the ROM, to see whether any of them waits on a route decision. None does. The prologue discriminator flags none of them, and every one classifies as structural-topology, missing-extra-code or scheduling-floor with wrong_instructions between 588 and 2582, meaning the emitted instructions themselves differ rather than the registers or the frame. A route failure looks like 08006b84, correct instructions with a contradicted prologue and wrong_instructions of 3. These drafts are roughly half-reconstructed and their residuals are reconstruction work, so nothing in that batch should be held back waiting on compiler routing.
